config.matrix_grid: all diagonal matrices from the Cartesian product of positive level and slope grids
config.affine_calibration: a+c*q(t); equal total later-observation weight per tuning stay
config.selection: minimum equal-stay tuning later check loss; parameters and candidate frozen before assessment

config.public_output_policy: aggregate results only; local assessment metrics stay in ignored .review-work
